title: Enterprise Activity Schema
description: Canonical representation of an activity within an enterprise business process.

sequence_number.description: Execution order of the activity within the process.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor responsible for performing the activity.

system_id.description: Identifier of the primary system supporting the activity.

input_documents.description: Documents or information required before the activity begins.

output_documents.description: Documents or information produced by the activity.

business_rule_ids.description: Business rules governing execution of the activity.

next_activity.description: Identifier of the next activity in the normal process flow.

exception_flow.description: Alternative flow followed when an exception occurs.

estimated_duration.description: Estimated duration required to complete the activity.

automation_candidate.description: Indicates whether the activity is a potential candidate for automation.
